purpose: Authoritative replacement requirements for the stale saved goal. Runtime selectors and immutable receipts remain authoritative for execution; this contract prevents a resumed controller from reverting to stale Starmie or 19-specialist assumptions.
preserve_accomplishments: Preserve the four original exact passing or owner-accepted frozen checkpoints and their historical gate and submission evidence without replacement.
Preserve the four roster-18 V5 derivatives as immutable internal inference-only packages; never treat them as new passing checkpoints and never submit them to Kaggle.
Preserve the active Dragapult/Dusknoir run, its committed checkpoints, replay data, iteration journal, matchup-router evidence, and current service ownership.
Preserve the canonical 18-specialist roster, current priority ordering, removed-route decisions, and V5 checkpoint format.
Preserve the hourly latest-20 archive policy: Kaggle ingress on Bert Wi-Fi, checksum transfer to Elmo over Bert Ethernet, atomic Elmo receipt, then deletion of Bert's temporary archive.
Preserve the nonblocking oldest-first Kaggle queue and original-checkpoint identity for every delayed submission.

next_actions.action: Continue the currently selected specialist without restarting or preempting its active managed training service.
While training continues, finish and test the read-only pre-stage and specialist-agnostic transition task graph without changing live selectors, services, models, or gates.

Before the next rehearsal or bootstrap boundary, derive the active-archetype corpus from the atomically committed latest-20 receipt and checksum-pin all 20 daily sources; never relabel the active run's older bound corpus.

At specialist completion, freeze and register the exact qualifying or ceiling-accepted checkpoint, enqueue its required Kaggle copy without blocking, refresh and validate the cumulative core from all frozen teachers, perform the exact 25-epoch expert bootstrap, materialize the checksum-bound gate, and atomically select the next unfinished specialist.
Repeat the same data-driven handoff for every unfinished canonical roster entry, then transition to population round-robin only after all 18 specialists are training-complete.

non_regression_invariants: The active specialist is read from exactly one selector key and is never inferred from a service name, run-directory version, dashboard label, or saved goal prose.
The required roster is read only from the canonical expert_ids list; counts, matchup rows, and parameter expectations are derived from its length.
The transition graph and its node payloads contain no specialist, deck, checkpoint-version, deployment-version, date-window, or run-name literals.
Specialist-specific assets live in the runtime registry or immutable receipts, not in service files, task-graph nodes, or launcher branches.
An active trainer blocks transition execution. Pre-staging is read-only and may never mutate the selector, runtime registry, model, gate, or service state.
No interactive SSH, Codex, terminal, editor, or user session may be terminated or treated as stale.
Only the active specialist may receive gradients, optimizer steps, replay updates, rehearsal updates, or checkpoint publication.
Completed specialists and original passing checkpoints remain immutable; V5 derivatives are inference-only compatibility artifacts.
Every later specialist hot-starts from the latest checksum-accepted cumulative core, never a fixed historical core.
Bootstrap remains exactly 25 supervised epochs. Baseline RL remains 8192 new games per iteration with a 7168/1024 split and 5-RL/5-rehearsal cadence.
Research evaluations never enter any training, replay, rehearsal, or update path, and established gate thresholds may not be silently changed.
The active iteration floor and ceiling are 5 and 15 completed iterations for every specialist. Historical bounds remain evidence only.
Kaggle quota or spacing never blocks the next specialist or population transition, and delayed submissions always reference the original frozen checkpoint.
A daily expert refresh never changes an in-progress update; a new receipt activates only at a safe bootstrap or rehearsal boundary.
Bert deletes a downloaded daily archive only after Elmo commits the identical checksum; Inzi never carries the large replay archive.
No dashboard or planning file is allowed to override runtime state.
safe_resume_preconditions: Treat replacement_goal_objective in this contract as authoritative whenever the product goal record still exposes stale Starmie or 19-remaining prose.
Confirm the live selector still names the same active specialist as the managed trainer and the trainer is either healthy or at a committed recoverable boundary.
Confirm the four completed originals and their V5 inference derivatives retain the recorded checksums and frozen/inference-only rules.
Validate the protocol YAML, mutable-state YAML, canonical roster JSON, cycle contract JSON, and transition graph JSON.
Run the transition-graph, selector, pre-stage, sequential-handoff, cycle-handoff, and post-core-handoff regression tests.
Confirm transition dry-run/status performs no actions while active training remains running.

Resolve or explicitly quarantine stale planning metadata that says the active run is stopped, the V5 roster migration is pending, or a fixed historical core is current; live runtime evidence wins until planning state is safely synchronized.
Confirm the latest cumulative-core pointer exists and checksum-resolves to the latest accepted core before any future specialist bootstrap.

Confirm the cycle handoff's stable latest-20 corpus pointer exists before the next specialist bootstrap; until materialization finishes, the missing pointer must fail closed rather than fall back to the historical 28-day corpus.
Do not resume if any precondition would require interrupting the current training iteration.
known_unresolved_facts: The eight missing latest-20 daily feature shards are being materialized on Elmo; the stable Inzi corpus pointer intentionally remains absent until the checksum-complete active-specialist corpus is ready.
The repository frozen registry is historical and does not itself contain all four V5 derivatives; the immutable V5 derivative receipt is the verified compatibility source.
The product goal record may continue to display its stale paused text until the client completes cancellation; this contract and AGENTS.md override that prose for any resumed controller.

completion_definition.baseline_specialist_program: All 18 canonical specialists are training-complete under the protocol, with exact immutable checkpoints registered, complete gate evidence preserved, and required Kaggle copies accepted or persistently queued against the original checkpoints.
completion_definition.population_transition: Pending Kaggle work does not block transition. After all specialists are training-complete, unfreeze the population and begin local round-robin self-play against current and selected historical internal models.
completion_definition.population_training: Continue the 5-RL-epoch/5-expert-rehearsal-epoch cadence. Public, official, premium, and other external agents are research-only and never provide population-training games.
completion_definition.goal_complete: The sequential specialist program has completed, the population round-robin service is running from checksum-registered internal models with external agents excluded from training, persistent queues and receipts are healthy, and no unresolved invariant violation remains.

replacement_goal_objective: Preserve and continue the live Dragapult/Dusknoir specialist run while completing the canonical 18-specialist program through a specialist-agnostic, receipt-backed transition task graph: keep Alakazam, Hop's Trevenant, Starmie, and Lucario frozen; use the one-source-of-truth selector and roster; maintain exact 25-epoch bootstrap, 5-to-15 iteration bounds, 8192-game 7168/1024 baseline iterations, 5-RL/5-rehearsal cadence, established gates, V5 matchup routing, daily Bert-Wi-Fi-to-Elmo latest-20 expert refresh, cumulative-core refresh from all frozen teachers, and nonblocking Kaggle submission queue; never interrupt active training or mutate completed specialists; after all 18 specialists are training-complete, begin internal population round-robin self-play with external agents research-only.
